purpose: Give the model-and-harness system standing authority to make and execute product decisions without user or human review gates while preserving factual evidence, recoverability, and required external provider state.

authority.default_execution_rule: For an in-scope product task, continue through implementation, validation, delivery, merge, deployment, and verification without requesting subjective approval.
authority.blocked_rule: Stop only for a missing external capability or credential, an unrecoverable or destructive action outside the requested scope, a failed required machine gate, or an objective conflict that the harness cannot resolve from product truth and evidence.

acceptance.ordinary_change: trusted OpenAI Codex Action exact-diff review over the immutable PR head plus task-relevant deterministic tests
acceptance.high_risk_change: two isolated trusted workflow review jobs over the same immutable diff plus task-relevant deterministic tests and rollback evidence
acceptance.trusted_workflow_bootstrap: A new pull_request_target reviewer cannot review its own installation PR. Merge that one bootstrap under the pre-existing protected checks plus two independent out-of-band exact-diff model runs, configure the external OpenAI API credential, prove both isolated jobs and the aggregate check on a follow-up PR, then cut branch protection to trusted-model-review.
acceptance.domain_record_boundary: model-acceptance.v2 proves exact JSON input binding and decision shape, not cryptographic model execution provenance. Such records gain repository authority only on a head that passes trusted-model-review. Media-consumption claims additionally require a trusted-media-run-receipt.v1 whose exact bytes pass GitHub Artifact Attestation verification against the fixed card-make main workflow and type-specific semantic validation. The structural verifier now exists, but no real attested receipt or formal media type registration exists, so formal media evidence remains fail closed.

methodology_refresh.refresh_rule: Before a major harness expansion or model migration, recheck current official model, tool, context, eval, and harness guidance; adopt changes only after representative repository evals.
